::: {#def-pure-function}
#### Pure function, side effect

A **side effect** of a piece of code is any change it makes besides returning a value,
such as changing a variable, printing, or writing a file.

A function in a program is **pure** [@wikipedia_pure_function] if

- it returns the same value whenever it is called with the same arguments, and
- it has no side effects.

A pure function computes a mathematical function (@def-function) of its arguments.

:::
